question: Starting with $$A=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 & 2 \\ -1 & 3 & 1 \\ 2 & -2 & 0\end{bmatrix},$$ perform the column transformations $C_2\rightarrow C_2+2C_1$ and then $C_3\rightarrow -C_3$. Obtain the transformed matrix.
explanation:
First column transformation
Applying $C_2\rightarrow C_2+2C_1$, the new second column is $$\begin{bmatrix}0\\3\\-2\end{bmatrix}+2\begin{bmatrix}1\\-1\\2\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}2\\1\\2\end{bmatrix}$$
Thus, $$A\rightarrow\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 2 \\ -1 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & 2 & 0\end{bmatrix}$$
Second column transformation
Applying $C_3\rightarrow -C_3$, $$\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 2 \\ -1 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & 2 & 0\end{bmatrix}\rightarrow\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -2 \\ -1 & 1 & -1 \\ 2 & 2 & 0\end{bmatrix}$$
